fullContent:
Nisakathakadi Kashayam 
 Reference: Sahasrayogam 
 Nisakathakadi Kashayam is a very famous liquid Ayurvedic medicine which is used in the treatment of pre-diabetes, diabetes and its complications. 
 Ingredients 
 
 Nisha – Turmeric – Curcuma longa 
 Kataka – Clearing nut – Strychnos potatorum 
 Paranti – Ixora coccinea 
 
 Lodhra – Symplocos racemosa 
 Amalaki – Emblica officinalis 
 Bhadrika – Aerva lanata 
 Mehari moola – Gymnema sylvestre 
 Usheera – Vetiveria zizanioides 
 
 How to Make? 
 Boil the above ingredients with water till it is reduced to 1/4th part and then filtered. 
 Dosage 
 Take 12 – 24 ml, before food, at about 6 am and 6pm or as directed by an Ayurvedic doctor. 
 Indications 
 
 Diabetes mellitus 
 Diabetic complications such as neuritis 
 
 Note: It should only be taken under strict supervision of Ayurveda medical practitioners. 
 
 Note:- This is pure classical Ayurvedic medicine and should be strictly consumed only after prescription of an Ayurvedic doctor and to be taken under medical supervision only.
